name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v5.84: OTA app-update now supports two separate app lines. The app-update endpoint, revert report and version heartbeat already existed and answer for any machine, but a single global release meant a fridge could be served the coil APK. Releases are now keyed per app (coil vs fridge), chosen from the machine model (GR- = fridge), so publishing one never overwrites the other and a fridge only ever gets the fridge build. Publish accepts app: coil|fridge; the legacy single release is treated as the coil line for backward compatibility. Cumulative over v5.83.
